title: Fractions and Decimals
tagline: Equivalent fractions, adding and multiplying them, and decimals.

skills.title: Equivalent fractions
skills.objective: Simplify a fraction to its lowest terms.

levels.title: Equivalent Fractions
levels.objective: Simplify a fraction by dividing the top and bottom by the same number.

lesson.intro: The same amount can be written as different fractions.
steps: Divide the top and the bottom by a number that goes into both.
Keep going until nothing else divides both: that's its lowest terms.

example.question: Simplify 12/18
example.note: Dividing by 6 at once does it in one step.

lesson.remember: Do the same to the top and the bottom.

levels.title: Adding and Multiplying Fractions
levels.objective: Add fractions with a common bottom, and multiply tops and bottoms.

lesson.intro: To add fractions, their bottoms must match.
steps: Same bottom: add the tops, keep the bottom. 1/5 + 2/5 = 3/5.
Different bottoms: change both to a bottom they share first.
To multiply: tops times tops, bottoms times bottoms.

example.question: Work out 1/4 + 1/6
example.note: 12 is the smallest bottom both go into.

levels.title: Fractions and Decimals
levels.objective: Change a fraction to a decimal, and a decimal to a fraction in its lowest terms.

lesson.intro: A decimal is a fraction with a bottom of 10, 100 or 1000.

example.question: Write 3/20 as a decimal
example.note: Multiply the top and the bottom by 5.

levels.title: Fractions Challenge
levels.objective: Show you can simplify, add, subtract and convert fractions and decimals.

lesson.intro: Everything from this path, a little harder.
steps: Simplify with the biggest number that divides both.
Take away fractions with the same bottom.
Add decimals with their points lined up.
